text:
sarah: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem — ingest lag + dedupe edge-case caused ~157 affected accounts to see delayed usage (tokens held in buffer for 18–36h). We need a tight remediation plan: backfill credits, reissue corrected invoices where material, and add detection to avoid recurrence. I put a brief action list below.

omar: Thanks. Can someone own invoice reissue + customer comms? Need owner + timeline so we can decide whether to push invoices or issue credits.

raj: I'll own the ingest fix (idempotency + dedupe logic). Target: deploy canary with hotfix by Tue EOD 2026-03-24. I'll also add a small smoke test to assert per-customer token delta < 1% on sample window.

lina: I'll coordinate backfill and credits math. Need CSV of affected accounts + token delta buckets (small/medium/large). @finance-bot can you generate the list?

finance-bot: Export ready: /exports/2026-03-20/affected_accounts_2798765432.csv (rows: 157, checksum: abc123def). Columns: account_id, email, tokens_missing, invoice_id, region.

sarah: Action items (assigned):
1) Ingest fix (dedupe/idempotency) — owner: raj — ETA: Tue 2026-03-24 EOD.
2) Backfill & credits calculation — owner: lina — ETA: Thu 2026-03-26 midday.
3) Invoice reissue / notification plan — owner: omar — ETA: Fri 2026-03-27 COB.
4) Postmortem writeup + root cause annex — owner: sarah — ETA: Mon 2026-03-30.
5) 24h ingest-lag metric + alert -> #incidents — owner: raj — ETA: Wed 2026-03-25.

omar: Add QA step: before credits run, sample 25 accounts across buckets and reconcile expected vs backfilled tokens. Approve only if sample passes.

oliver: I'll prepare a smoke test script for the reconciliation compare. Quick snippet I used locally:
```
-- sample SQL to compute token gap
SELECT account_id, SUM(expected_tokens) - SUM(ingested_tokens) AS token_gap
FROM token_reconciliations
WHERE window_start >= '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY token_gap DESC
LIMIT 25;
```
PR for the test in a few hours.

raj: pushed hotfix branch. CI flaky on serial tests, pinging eng-sre.

eng-sre-bot: Canary deploy queued (canary group: 5% traffic). Estimated rollout time: ~45m. Monitoring: p50 latency, token-ingest-throughput.

lina: For comms, I'll draft two templates: (A) credits applied + explanation, (B) corrected invoice + instructions. Will share drafts here by Thu AM.

sarah: I'll create calendar hold for Thu 09:30 follow-up and update the linear ticket with owners + dates. Also adding a note to link the postmortem to the billing runbook.

omar: One more ask — add a recurrent regression check for 'ingest lag > 6h' and a weekly digest in finance reports so we spot patterns.

raj: will add metric. initial query I'll use (iterating on edge cases):
```
SELECT account_id, max(processed_at - received_at) AS max_lag_secs
FROM ingest_events
WHERE processed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING max_lag_secs > 21600; -- 6h
```
I'll wire alerting to #incidents once thresholds stabilize.

oliver: small note — for large accounts we should prefer credits over reissued invoices to avoid churn. tagging product for policy if needed.

lina: agreed. I'll flag accounts where reissue threshold > $1k for manual review.

sarah: Good discussion. Summary: owners and dates agreed, CSV exported, canary in flight. We'll meet Thu 09:30 to confirm backfill sample results and customer comms. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
